models.name: Bonsai 2 27B
models.why: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B on a single 12GB RTX 3060: the PQ2_0 build decodes at ~35 t/s with 220K context resident and 7.21GB of weights, the PTQ1_0 build trades down to 26 t/s for the full 262K context in 5.95GB. Both need PrismML's llama.cpp fork — stock llama.cpp rejects the files.

engines.quant: PQ2_0 ternary packing (~1.72 bits/weight), Q4_0 KV cache; -ngl 999 -c 220000 -fa on --jinja -np 1
engines.engine_min_version: PrismML llama.cpp fork, llama-server -ngl 999 -c 220000 -fa on --jinja -np 1 --cache-type-k q4_0 --cache-type-v q4_0

engines.quant: PTQ1_0 ternary packing, full 262K context resident
engines.engine_min_version: PrismML llama.cpp fork (stock llama.cpp rejects the ternary files)
